mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id AS senderId, receiver_id AS receiverId, content, is_read AS isRead, create_time AS createTime FROM ( SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, create_time FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{me} AND receiver_id = #{peer}) OR (sender_id = #{peer} AND receiver_id = #{me}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY t.id ASC
